title: Generator-mediated benchmark contamination without pixel overlap
note: Fine-tuning a generator on test-domain imagery leaks benchmark performance with zero nearest-neighbor overlap; redefines what 'no test images in training' certifies. Meta-science with field-level reach.

title: Sim-to-real gap axes do not add: interaction terms dominate
note: Attacks the single-axis ablation-decomposition paradigm used across domain-shift studies; constructive replacement is factorial gap measurement.

title: Self-generation loop collapse rate predictable from boundary-entropy loss per cycle
note: Converges with w14w2b-079 from an independent shard, raising its prior; see JC2-CV-01.

title: Critical period for renderer-artifact lock-in
note: Early artifact randomization prevents shortcut reliance that later randomization cannot undo; clean early-vs-late experimental design; training-dynamics science.

title: Normalization-statistic re-estimation as mandatory null model for sim-to-real
note: Embarrassing-baseline attack: norm-stat re-estimation may recover much of complex adaptation methods' gains; comes with a corrective reporting protocol.

title: Domain-adversarial training gains as gradient-noise regularization
note: Matched-noise control without any domain discriminator; decisive debunk design aimed at a whole method family.

title: Uncanny valley for training data: high-realism synthetic hurts more than low-realism
note: Near-domain errors absorbed as facts, far-domain errors discounted as noise; memorable contrarian claim, testable with realism-graded corpora.

title: Shift algebra: combined-shift performance composes multiplicatively from single shifts
note: A compositional law enabling deployment forecasting from single-shift measurements; rare theory-flavored idea in the corpus.

title: Sim-to-real gap is decoder-localized, not encoder-localized
note: Frozen synthetic-trained encoder + real-tuned decoder recovers most of the gap; cheap decisive freeze/swap experiment redirecting adaptation effort.

title: Steganographic collusion in joint restoration+segmentation pipelines
note: Restoration module passes segmentation hints as imperceptible signals rather than improving image quality; perturbation-sensitivity test in hours on released checkpoints.

title: Seed-instability as training-free restoration-hallucination detector
note: Hallucinated structure varies across sampler seeds, recovered structure does not; constructive detector. Designed counterpoint w14w2b-019 (deterministic samplers make hallucination reproducible).

title: Photon noise is informative signal that denoising removes
note: Noise variance encodes luminance and segmenters measurably use it; physics-grounded contrarian claim against restoration-first pipelines.

title: Diffusion segmentation samples are under-dispersed vs annotator distributions
note: Attacks the headline 'distribution over plausible masks' claim; cross-reference canonical w14-0054 ambiguity-collapse (JC2-DX-03).

title: Most mask-diffusion models are secretly deterministic
note: Output barely depends on noise input, making the diffusion machinery dead weight at inference; embarrassing audit of a hot method family.

title: Task utility as a third axis of the perception-distortion tradeoff
note: Utility non-monotonic in both perception and distortion; theory framing that organizes the entire restoration-for-segmentation shard.

title: Virtual staining is segmentation laundering
note: Evaluating on virtually stained images double-counts the staining model's prior and reports information the input never contained; clinical evaluative-validity stakes.

title: Segmentation accuracy oscillates with codec GOP structure
note: Masks measurably better on I-frames than B-frames; a periodic deployment artifact invisible to shuffled-frame evaluation.

title: Scoring restored-image segmentation against clean GT credits hallucination
note: Evidence-limited ground-truth protocol flips method rankings; evaluation-protocol leverage over the whole restoration-utility literature.

title: Emergent zero-shot segmentation abilities as thresholded-metric artifacts
note: Imports the emergence-is-a-mirage analysis to dense prediction; pure re-analysis, no training required.

title: Annotation scaling converges to protocol bias, not ground truth
note: Epistemological claim about the limits of same-protocol label scaling; reframes what benchmark GT measures.

title: Certified robustness certifies interiors, never boundaries
note: Structural gap: certificates concentrate on easy pixels, making certified dense robustness semantically hollow; cheap to demonstrate on published certified models.

title: Skin-tone segmentation gaps are mostly photometric, not representational
note: Luminance-matched evaluation predicted to erase most of the gap; high-stakes contrarian with a controlled decisive test; pairs with w14w2c-046 (annotation-quality locus) and w14w2c-056 (benchmark-composition locus).

title: Fixing existing label errors beats collecting new images per annotation-hour
note: Direct practice-changing annotation-economics claim with a clean matched-budget design.

title: Tail-class quality is bottlenecked by head-class boundary quality
note: Counterintuitive causal structure: fixing head labels helps the tail more than adding tail data; clean intervention experiment.

title: CAM-based weakly-supervised segmentation decade compresses to near-noise under unified tuning
note: Field-level replication audit; highest evidential leverage among the shard's debunk family (see JC2-MC-03).

title: Benchmark deltas below the GT reproducibility floor are unfalsifiable
note: Measurement-theory floor complementing canonical w14-0243 (statistical power); computable by re-annotation alone.

title: Distillation transfers the teacher's failure map
note: Error-correlated students destroy ensemble and audit value while accuracy looks unchanged; safety-relevant compression science.

title: Crowd recall is lost inside the suppression stage, not the network
note: Pre-NMS oracle recall stays high while post-NMS recall collapses; reframes the crowd-detection bottleneck with a cheap oracle experiment.

title: Many detector false positives are correct detections missing from GT
note: Cross-detector agreement estimates GT incompleteness without new annotation; meta-science on benchmark ground truth.

title: Negative vocabulary is the underused half of open-vocab detection
note: Adding confusable distractor class names cuts false positives more than positive-prompt tuning; constructive, cheap, deployable.

title: Below a size floor, small-object AP measures annotation noise
note: Inter-annotator box IoU bounds achievable AP for tiny objects; leaderboard-validity claim converging with w14w2c-108 and w14D2-061 (JC2-CV-10).

title: DETR query tiling has coverage gaps that predict systematic misses
note: Gap map extractable from the trained model without any test data; elegant mechanistic prediction with a constructive fix path.

title: The NMS-free property of set-prediction detectors is distribution-bound
note: Duplicate rates climb under domain shift; deployed DETR pipelines silently need an emergency suppression stage; deployment-critical audit of the DETR narrative.

title: Foundation detectors fail non-photographic imagery at the proposal stage
note: Regions are never proposed on x-ray/sketch inputs even though crops classify correctly; inverts the assumed bottleneck and is directly actionable.

title: Region binding, not recognition, is detection's scaling bottleneck
note: Small foundation models recognize what they cannot bind to regions; big-picture scaling science for detection.

title: Novel-object detection and OOD rejection are opposed uses of one signal
note: Methods form a single trade-off curve; claimed simultaneous wins are operating points, an evaluation artifact; reorganizes an evaluation subfield.

title: BPE token-count bias in open-vocabulary dense scores
note: Multi-token class names are scored on a different scale than single-token names; mechanistic, universal, testable in a day.

title: Token-limit right-truncation deletes restrictive modifiers
note: English places disambiguating clauses last, so silent truncation corrupts exactly the informative part of long queries; immediate engineering fix.

title: Lateral spatial language broken because flip augmentation erased chirality
note: Vertical language reliable, lateral broken - a training-cause claim; test-time twin w14E-020 (flip-TTA averages left with right) is the deployment bug version.

title: Register-token artifacts create position-stable phantom detections
note: High-norm ViT tokens attract text similarity at consistent grid locations; timely mechanistic claim, cheap to verify.

title: Coordinate-emitting VLMs snap to round numbers
note: Numeric tokenization imposes a quantization prior structuring localization error; decisive histogram test on any coordinate-emitting model.

title: Alignment tax on pixels: safety tuning silently degrades dense outputs
note: Sensitive-adjacent queries degrade without any refusal being issued; novel intersection of alignment science and dense prediction.

title: Text-only probe forecasts per-sample grounding failure
note: Benchmarks are partly language-solvable; benchmark-validity result yielding a reusable diagnostic.

title: Negative-space referents are unrepresentable in dense grounding
note: 'The gap between the buildings' asks for a region defined by absence; clean conceptual boundary of current architectures.

title: State-referential masks never update: grounding as one-shot event
note: 'The traffic light that is red' keeps its mask after the light turns green; reframes referring video segmentation as maintained belief.

title: Self-consuming generation loops collapse boundary complexity first
note: Near-identical A/B claims with an early-warning metric; E's variant is salience-drift in pseudo-label bootstrapping. Merge A/B, keep E distinct.

title: Latent-autoencoder downsampling imposes a thin-structure floor
note: Same architectural-floor hypothesis from generation-side and feature-side; merge into one testable law.

title: JPEG/codec grid artifacts become learned boundary/detection priors
note: Also overlaps canonical w14-0096 (JPEG blocks x patch grid). Consolidate as one compression-artifact-physics program.

title: Copy-paste/compositing augmentation teaches edge-artifact shortcuts
note: w14w2a-034 claims the opposite sign (copy-paste wins at matched compute) - a designed disagreement worth preserving explicitly.

title: Caption/word frequency governs per-class open-vocab quality
note: Three-shard convergence containing the corpus's only lexical near-duplicate pair (w14w2c-113/w14E-106, Jaccard 0.36); strongest single merge target in wave2.

title: Regression-to-the-frequent: rare inputs replaced by frequent lookalikes
note: FOUR-shard convergence spanning restoration, contrarian, detection, VLM. Dual signal: candidate unifying cross-domain law AND top dedup priority.

title: Vocabulary/query-set interference in open-vocab scoring
note: Same score-renormalization mechanism; merge to one idea with detection and segmentation instantiations.

title: Temporal-consistency optimization installs persistence bias
note: Coherent program: keep benchmark-design member (b-120) and mechanism member (b-103) distinct; D2-113 is the counterpoint (flicker is thresholding, not representation).

title: Benchmark contamination via web crawls / generated-content drift
note: 10+ members; wave1 canonical already covers contamination (w14-0229, w14-0238). Overcrowded: cap hard; keep mechanistically distinct members (a-112 ecosystem drift, b-115 restoration-side memorization, c-110 post-crawl protocol).

title: Small-object metrics bounded by annotation noise
note: Same measurement-floor logic in segmentation and detection; merge with task-specific predictions.

title: Resampling/aliasing/upsampling mechanics create systematic spatial biases
note: Overlaps canonical w14-0099 (half-pixel bilinear offset). Consolidate as one resampling-mechanics program, not six ideas.

title: Leaderboard metrics diverge from fixed-threshold deployment behavior
note: Genre-wide pattern; keep the 2-3 sharpest instantiations and fold the rest.

title: Paraphrase disagreement duplicates the canonical prompt-perturbation-as-uncertainty family
note: Language-space instance of the canonical family; merge as instantiation, not a new idea.

title: Patch-grid boundary ceiling duplicates the canonical tokenization-floor family
note: w14E-064 (language injected at too-coarse fusion scales) is the only genuinely new mechanism; keep it, fold the rest.

title: Diffusion mask under-dispersion duplicates the canonical ambiguity-collapse family
note: Same phenomenon, new (diffusion) mechanism; cross-reference rather than duplicate.

title: TTA per-image regressions duplicates canonical TTA mean-vs-tail inversion
note: Near-identical claim generalized beyond medical; merge.

title: Auto-exposure transient dropouts parallels canonical auto-exposure self-hiding fires
note: Same camera-policy mechanism class, different domain; cross-reference.

title: Wave2 negation cluster expands the canonical negation-blindness idea
note: Restructure as one canonical negation program with sub-hypotheses (absence, complement sets, negated attributes, scaling claim) instead of admitting five near-siblings.

title: Token-pruning-deletes-rare-objects is a near-clone of canonical w14-0167
note: Note w14-0073 claims the opposite sign (pruning as regularizer); preserve the designed disagreement.

title: Annotation-convention artifacts re-emerging per territory duplicate the canonical convention family
note: Admit only members with new mechanisms; w14E-102 (per-word convention keying) is the sharpest.

title: Audit-genre monoculture persists from wave1
note: The overwhelming majority of 638 ideas are diagnose/measure/expose/debunk studies; constructive contributions (methods, objectives, task formulations, dataset artifacts) are roughly 30 of 638 by one-line reading. Wave2 steering fixed territory, not genre. Impose a constructive-genre quota on any wave3; protect the constructive minority at consolidation.

title: Forecasting template repetition
note: 'X is measurable/predictable from Y before/without training' appears in ~162 ideas (Worker D: 47, Worker A: 37 heaviest). Individually fine, corpus-level one rhetorical machine; provide as negative constraint to future generators.

title: Debunk template repetition inside Worker C
note: 'Gains vanish once baseline is tuned / compute matched' recurs across ~20+ C ideas (c-011..c-022, c-069, c-072, c-074, c-076, c-097, c-100) plus w14w2b-121, w14D2-119. Within-mandate but one paper shape; rank by evidential leverage of the debunked target and cap the family.

title: Theme overcrowding: contamination and calibration
note: Contamination/leakage: ~57 wave2 ideas plus existing canonical family (see JC2-CV-09). Calibration/confidence: ~87 wave2 mentions plus wave1's 34-idea uncertainty family. Cap both at consolidation.

title: Model anchoring migrated, not removed
note: SAM anchoring is gone (1 mention corpus-wide), but Worker B is ~100% diffusion-anchored and Worker E predominantly CLIP-style contrastive-anchored. GAN/autoregressive/flow generators, non-contrastive vision-language models, DINO-style SSL lineages nearly absent. Portfolio ages with two model families instead of one.

title: 3D beyond LiDAR-driving
note: Indoor point clouds, meshes, NeRF/Gaussian-splatting segmentation: zero coverage across both waves.

title: Interactive / human-in-the-loop segmentation science
note: Correction economics, interaction protocols, mixed-initiative labeling; wave2 nearly dropped it (only w14w2c-065/094/101 touch it).

title: Constructive-genre generation quota
note: Architectures, training objectives, task reformulations, benchmark/dataset artifacts with falsifiable design hypotheses; the persistent genre gap phrased as a territory.

title: Embodied / closed-loop perception
note: Dense predictions consumed by planners/trackers, action-conditioned evaluation, utility calibration (only w14D2-021, w14D2-040 touch it).

title: Multimodal sensor-fusion dense prediction
note: RGB-D, thermal, event, multispectral fusion science; only incidental members (w14w2b-113, w14E-117).

title: Document / diagram / UI / text-dense imagery
note: Layout segmentation science absent; only w14E-053/054 touch typography.

title: Instance/panoptic task-formulation science and multi-task interference
note: Segmentation x detection x depth cross-talk; only w14D2-002 and w14w2c-109 adjacent.

title: Continual / lifelong deployment adaptation
note: Drift trajectories exist in Worker A (a-058/077/078/130) but no continual-learning science (rehearsal, plasticity, forgetting under deployment schedules).

title: Theory and formal analysis of dense prediction
note: Sample complexity, invariance theory, generalization bounds under spatial correlation; only w14w2a-125/127, w14w2c-009.

title: Human perception and annotation science as measurement instrument
note: Psychophysics of boundary perception, rater modeling beyond convention artifacts; w14w2c-112, w14E-100 incidental.

title: Inconsistent id_seed schemes with provenance hazard
note: Three conventions across five shards (w14w2a/b/c-### vs w14D2-### vs w14E-###). w14E-### visually parallels wave1's shard scheme (w14A-###), inviting provenance confusion though no actual collision exists. Normalize at merge; keep original ids in a provenance field.

title: Unverified absence-as-fact phrasing
note: 27 ideas state 'has never been / nobody has / no one has' as fact (mostly in the problem field; Worker D heaviest with 12). Additionally: absence-of-practice one-lines (w14D2-077, w14D2-123, w14D2-124, w14E-020, w14E-032, w14E-119) and 17 unhedged why_possibly_novel absence claims (w14w2a-046/089/103/111, w14w2b-026/110, w14w2c-042, w14D2-009/018/038/044/077/103, w14E-042/047/112/120). None literature-verified; consolidator must downgrade all to 'not verified against prior work' before any canonical merge.

title: Uniform evidence_status HYPOTHESIS (638/638)
note: Correct and honest; no evidence gradient is inferable from this field. Ranking must come from judge flags.
